axes.description: visible energy of the cell (Birks and longitudinal-response corrected)
axes.name: E

axes.description: energy-weighted folded step time minus the event's window end; below the first edge: inside the window (survival 1), above the last: the last bin
axes.name: v

description: Parametric digi response: per log bin of the visible cell energy, a pool of the full chain's outcomes (hit, hit energy / E, hit time - T) on training cells inside the digitisation window, and a survival curve in v = T - window end that multiplies the hit probability.

domain.coverage: E 0.01-300 MeV (clipped to the end bins); v -200 to 40 ns (below: inside the window, survival 1; above: the last bin)

fallbacks.description: an empty energy bin borrows the nearest filled bin's pool (empty_bins)
fallbacks.name: empty_bin

dtype.notes: to_device keeps fixed dtypes in both modes: float64 edges, survival and draws, float32 ratio and dt; the outputs are float32

generator.configuration: Sim_crystal.txt, CsI-waveform-2020-02-12, ReadoutNoise, CsI-propag-2020-07-29, calo_geometry_run1430; adc2mev stockio.adc_to_mev; PE statistics, travel time and noise on; reco bunch-time smear off; caps per event: steps 80, photoelectrons 9000, rows 48, digis 48, hits 32; digi_length 96, event_hits 64, rounds 8; batches of 1,024 events, no overflow
generator.name: calofastsim device chain (make_steps_chain stages) with the production response

name: calo.digi_response.run1a

outputs.description: hit time T + dt (before the reco bunch-time smear)
outputs.name: t

release.entry_point: calofastsim.param_response.build (defaults: E_EDGES, V_EDGES, SURVIVAL_E_MIN 3 MeV, POOL_MAX 4000, seed 1), from a copy of that working tree

rng.device: jax.random key (draw): split into the pool draw and the survival draw, one float64 uniform each per cell
rng.host: none (build: numpy default_rng(seed) for the pool subsample)

seeds.chain: jax.random.PRNGKey(4000 + batch), split into (k_pe, k_digi, unused)
seeds.timing: numpy default_rng(77000 + batch): pbtime = -200 - 5 * integers(0, 5) ns, mbtime 1695 ns, event length 1700 ns, marker 200, crystal length 200, on-spill

source.description: CaloShowerSteps of ten CeEndpoint training files through the full device chain (photoelectrons, digitisation, template fit, hits), float64, production response; 28,265 events, 312,265 cells (281,080 inside the window), read in sorted file order

validation.record: docs/approximations.md (W7 digi_response=parametric): leading-cluster peak, width, yield and shapes on held-out CE events, float32 and float64; the cluster count above 10 MeV misses (chi2 17/5); no declared criterion recorded
